answer: Before an identity may answer, it must solve a fresh proof-of-work puzzle bound to the epoch seed and its own key, taking about 40 seconds of CPU per identity. A farm of 540 fakes pays 360 CPU-minutes every epoch plus power, while one honest agent pays once, so cloning stops scaling. What carries the ocean here is verification, the sable of cost is what stops the farm, and the harbor of the record keeps every claim checkable.
